name: zinc-structures-full/v0
purpose: Control profile for P1: every one of the 14 deposited structures must pass the metal-site witness as declared. Expected to reject, because P1 keeps its reds; it exists to show the rejection.
limitations: Deposited structures only: geometry as deposited, with each method's own limits (NMR calculation restraints, crystallographic and cryo-EM coordinate error). Nothing here was simulated.

The distance windows are the typical values declared before P1 (grade L) and were not changed after seeing these files; small misses (0.007 A in one model of 1N0Z, 0.010 A at one 1AAY site) are reported as reds, not hidden.
The cross-check shares the donor-atom table, search radius and metal identity with the witness; it is independent in parsing, selection and arithmetic.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
